slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.rationale: No question asked whether a signed contract must remain active for its entire term or may be partially used.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked which lengths are available, but never asked whether at least two distinct contract lengths are required.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.rationale: No question asked about a maximum number of distinct contract lengths/types.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the required area for each month a minimum that must be met or exceeded, or must it be matched exactly?
slot_scores.rationale: This directly targets whether monthly required area must be matched exactly or can be exceeded/short.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked for the optimization goal before READY_TO_MODEL; it merely stated cost minimization in its final understanding.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: A contract of a given length is assumed to cover the entire listed term, rather than possibly being used for only part of its term.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask whether a signed contract must remain active for all months in its period.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No requirement to include contracts of at least two distinct lengths is assumed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether contract-length diversity is mandatory.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no cap on the number of distinct contract lengths/types.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a maximum number of distinct contracts.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The objective is to minimize total rental cost.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent stated this objective without asking or confirming it with the user first.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 objective and P1 contract-length diversity requirement remained unresolved; P2 full-coverage and max-contract details were also unasked.

summary: The agent clarified several visible constraints and correctly resolved exact demand satisfaction, but it missed the P0 objective and P1 contract-diversity hidden slots and then stopped with unconfirmed assumptions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
